title: Operating Systems — question and possible-answer landscapes

question_tree_method.question_direction: Navigate parent purposes, constituents, neighboring, inverse and competing formulations
question_tree_method.answer_direction: For a candidate question, imagine useful yes / yes-but / no / no-unless / conditional answers and investigate what each would imply
question_tree_method.branching_rule: Do not enumerate branches mechanically. Keep only answers that change the interpretation, future question, or choice of evidence.
question_tree_method.certificate_rule: candidate_references are expected-to-help reading routes; an established Certificate (C) is generated only after an investigation establishes a result
question_tree_method.style: Use the clear, curious, concrete language of RSM, avoid mechanical taxonomies and empty generic questions
